note: Two distinct legal entities appear in the batch. (1) M R DENTAL (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED — real, active exporter: 42 customs records, latest 2026-02-27, exports to UAE (Pacific Distribution FZE, Jebel Ali/Dubai) and UK (Mr. Dental Supplies Ltd, Old Woking), HS 39061090 (denture base polymer powder) and HS 90212100 (artificial acrylic teeth), B/L numbers 1068329, 8698065, 3344894, 9863947. It also imports (ARMA DENTAL DIS TICARET A.S., Turkey, HS 84807100 mould bases; WILLMANN & PEIN GMBH, Germany) — i.e. manufacturer_trader profile. Declared HS 901849 does NOT match any observed record: actual codes are 90212100 / 39061090 / 84807100, so per project rule 3 the code is corrected to the factual one and the company is kept (accepted_hs_corrected), not rejected. Industry claim "Нефтегаз и химия" (oil & gas / chemicals) is wrong — the company is dental consumables (artificial teeth, denture base powder), which explains the 39061090 polymer line but not an oil/gas profile. (2) MEADWAY DENTALS PRIVATE LIMITED — ImportKey pages for both slug variants (meadway-dentals-private-limited, meadway-dentals-pvt-ltd) render "Loading..." with zero shipment rows, zero suppliers, zero buyers: no customs trace found under that name. No evidence these two names are the same entity; the batch appears to have merged them. For Meadway: export_status none_found, domestic_status unknown, no supply traces found in reachable sources. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in free views.
